reuse.why: Extends the existing isSkippedByMonthActions predicate that copyPreviousMonth and every getMonthActionCategories action already share; there is no existing notes-tag helper to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in hasFixedTag; only the notes LEFT JOIN is repeated in the two pre-existing feeding queries (getBudgetData and getMonthActionCategories), which mirrors how group_hidden is already fetched.

placement.why: The predicate lives beside the other month-action skip rules in budget/actions.ts and the data is fetched in the queries that feed it.

scope.why: Predicate, two queries, a test and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: One named tag check inside the one shared skip predicate; future month-wide actions inherit it automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The new rule goes into isSkippedByMonthActions rather than being filtered at individual actions.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the parallel notes join in the two existing feeding queries.

one_place.where: hasFixedTag called from isSkippedByMonthActions in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth (via getBudgetData rows) and by setZero/set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg/setLastMonthSpending (via getMonthActionCategories).
